quote: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

activation.condition: A driver intends a left turn or another departure from a direct course. The selected C178244 branch is a left turn with another vehicle; district classification remains source dependent.

obligation.description: Give the intended turn signal continuously over the applicable final traveled distance, regardless of weather. Business or residential districts use 100 feet; other areas use 300 feet.

timing.description: During the last applicable distance before changing course.

parameter_refs.name: indicator_start_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: nonnegative engineering metres before turn onset

parameter_refs.name: district_type
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: business, residential or other; legal classification pending exact site evidence

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: optional closed interval of remaining approach metres

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: observed original-source continuous signal distance in feet; never commanded
